_doc: CANONICAL source-of-truth for ACC room geometry. docs/36 Stage 0. See docs/36_map_tightening_research.md §4/§6. Room FOOTPRINTS are duplicated across 4 artifacts (tools/gen_zone_greybox.js, tools/gen_map_design.js, the baked map_source/zm/zm_abandoned_cyber_city.map, and tools/gen_rooms.js for the inner chambers) plus the PaP origin lives in 2 GSC/JS literals. tools/validate_rooms.js asserts every copy matches THIS file. When the map-tightening overhaul shrinks a room, edit THIS file first, then propagate + re-validate. NOTE: spawner/box/perk/power entity ORIGINS are NOT tracked here — they live only in the .map and are hand-tuned (e.g. market dog is at y=1100, not the generator's computed center y=900), so the .map is authoritative for those; this file tracks only the duplicated geometry.
_units: BO3 Radiant units. +X=east, +Y=north, +Z=up. Coordinates verified against the baked .map (docs/36 geometry verification, 2026-06-15).

wall._doc: Room perimeter walls (the 6 greybox rooms + start). VERIFIED 20u thick / 256u tall — NOT the 16u/128u the old session brief assumed. floorTop=walkable z, floorBottom=bottom of the 16u floor slab.

rooms._doc: OUTER footprint = the floor-slab extent (x1<x2, y1<y2). Interior = inset by wall.thickness on all sides. start_zone is NOT emitted by gen_zone_greybox.js (it is the original template arena), so its footprint lives only in gen_map_design.js + the baked .map.

genRoomsShells._doc: KNOWN CONFLICT to reconcile in the overhaul (docs/36). tools/gen_rooms.js (run after gen_zone_greybox, with NO re-run guard before Stage 0) injected a SECOND closed box shell for vault+roof — see the '// ACC room shell: Server Vault/Rooftop Helipad' brushes (guid ACCB00xx). gen_rooms assumed those zones had no geometry, but the gen_zone_greybox rooms (rooms.<vault/roof>_zone.outer) WERE applied — so each of vault/roof now has TWO overlapping shells. The gen_rooms shell is 16u-walled, z[-16,144] (128u ceiling), and is actually LARGER in X than the greybox room (984 < 1119; -2416 < -2319) and uses DIFFERENT door-gap Y bands (y2474-2536 / y3120-3186) than the greybox room (y2300-2556 / y3100-3356). gen_rooms room(label, ix0, iy0, ix1, iy1, ...) takes the INTERIOR; walls inset OUTWARD by wallThickness, so bakedOuter = interior expanded by wallThickness (verified vs the baked floor brushes).

wallGaps._doc: Door/corridor openings cut into each room's E/W perimeter walls (keyed by gen_zone_greybox short name). [gapY1, gapY2] per side. All corridors run E-W so N/S room walls stay solid. These MUST stay aligned to the matching door slab + corridor floor when a room shrinks.

papOrigin._doc: Pack-a-Punch machine origin. Historically hardcoded in 2 places: tools/apply_entity_moves.js (the PaP-prefab move target) and scripts/.../_acc_perk_info.gsc (the proximity card; now a FALLBACK after the Stage-0 live-origin refactor — the GSC reads GetEntArray("pack_a_punch","script_noteworthy")[0].origin at runtime). Both literals must still equal this.
